item.title: UIDAI hikes Aadhaar PVC Card Fee: New Rates Effective January 2026
item.description: UIDAI has increased the Aadhaar PVC card service fee from ₹50 to ₹75 marking the first price revision since its introduction in 2020, effective from January 2026. The post UIDAI hikes Aadhaar PVC Card Fee: New Rates Effective January 2026 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Dead Witnesses, No Proof, 25-Year Delay: Allahabad HC Quashes “Afterthought” Case Against Man Over 1997 Illegal Land Lease
item.description: “The absence of any action for cancellation of deeds for such a prolonged period clearly indicates that the dispute is essentially civil and revenue in nature, and that the criminal machinery has been set in motion afterthought and as a substitute for appropriate civil remedies, which is impermissible in law.” The post Dead Witnesses, No Proof, 25-Year Delay: Allahabad HC Quashes “Afterthought” Case Against Man Over 1997 Illegal Land Lease appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: December 2025 State Legislation Roundup: Major Laws, Amendments & Policies You Must Know!
item.description: In December, states and UTs rolled out key reforms including Gujarat’s Shops and establishment reform, Rajasthan’s decriminalisation ordinance, and Karnataka’s police service revamp. The post December 2025 State Legislation Roundup: Major Laws, Amendments & Policies You Must Know! appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Can’t label a judge dishonest on a hunch’; SC sets aside Judicial Officer’s removal over 4 bail orders missing statutory reference
item.description: “It will be a dangerous proposition to hold that judgments and orders which do not refer expressly to statutory provisions are per se dishonest judgments”. The post ‘Can’t label a judge dishonest on a hunch’; SC sets aside Judicial Officer’s removal over 4 bail orders missing statutory reference appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay HC stays Maharashtra Cricket Association elections after Kedar Jadhav’s plea alleging nepotism in membership induction
item.description: “The Court is entitled to examine the decision-making process, particularly as to how about 400 new members were inducted in the MCA under different categories, in the face of allegations of illegality, arbitrariness, and nepotism.” The post Bombay HC stays Maharashtra Cricket Association elections after Kedar Jadhav’s plea alleging nepotism in membership induction appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Expressing desire to end India-Pakistan hostilities and return to peace is not sedition: Himachal Pradesh HC grants bail in Facebook Post Case
item.description: “The Pen Drive containing the images and the video showed that the accused chatted with someone, and both criticised the hostilities between India and Pakistan. They advocated that all people, irrespective of their religion, should stay together, and that the war served no fruitful purpose.” The post Expressing desire to end India-Pakistan hostilities and return to peace is not sedition: Himachal Pradesh HC grants bail in Facebook Post Case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Speculation can’t decide damages: Inside Delhi HC judgement clarifying evidence-based damages in trademark infringement
